name: Perils of Salvaging (2045)
description: Salvaging Night City (R. Talsorian Games), pp.3, 5. A short summary by Neon At Home; the DLC has the full text. Import this table to use your own wording: Neon At Home rolls from your copy. Edit a result's wording and Neon At Home shows yours; the peril's dice stay the module's.

results.text: A structure comes down on you. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it), and a Critical Injury to the Body.
You walk into a firefight. 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).
A radiation hot spot. High Level Radiation for 1d10 rounds: each, 2 damage straight to HP, as if Mildly On Fire. A Radiation Suit keeps it off.
The ground gives way under you. A 30m fall when the ground gives: 6d6 damage (armor soaks it), unless a Grapple Hand or Gun, or a DV15 Athletics Check to grab the edge, saves you.
A pocket of toxic gas. A pocket of toxic gas for a round, as a Vial of Biotoxin: beat DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs or take 3d6 straight to HP. An Anti-Smog Breathing Mask or an air supply keeps it off.
You grab a live wire. A live wire: electrocuted for a round, 6d6 damage (armor soaks it).
